outcome: Need for re-intubation within 48 h of application
cohort: The study included 122 infants (169 NIV-NAVA episodes) admitted to a major tertiary NICU in Australia between October 2017 and April 2021 who received NIV-NAVA support.
finding: NIV-NAVA was successfully integrated and applied in 85.2% of episodes, with 145 out of 169 episodes not requiring re-intubation within 48 hours for the indications of post-extubation, apnoea, and escalation.
